title: Split Button
lede: A button that offers a primary interaction coupled with a dropdown menu offering additional actions.

examples.heading: Default
examples.description: The button's primary action should be the first item in the dropdown menu.
examples.code:
const items = (<><SplitButtonMenuItem description="Save changes" title="Save" /><SplitButtonMenuItem description="Save changes and create a new production deployment" title="Save + Redeploy" /></>);
<SplitButton buttonProps={{ size: 'small', variant: 'default' }} menuButtonLabel="Select save method" menuItems={items} menuProps={{ width: 264 }}>Save</SplitButton>
<SplitButton buttonProps={{ size: 'medium', variant: 'default' }} menuButtonLabel="Select save method" menuItems={items} menuProps={{ width: 264 }}>Save</SplitButton>
